_comment: Smoke-test expectations for `uie doctor` (EVD-02). `scope` is the audit scope the doctor serves from this folder on a temporary 127.0.0.1 server; `expected` lists, per audit check, the primary criterion IDs the check must report on known-bad.html. A check may report more; it must not report fewer. `fields` are numeric minimums read from the check's checks.json entry. Entries owned by `interaction-checks` belong to the keyboard, dialogs, forms, live-regions and states checks; while such a check is not implemented (skipped), the doctor reports its expectations as pending and does not pass.

console._seeded: console.error and an uncaught exception during load

media._seeded: a 404 image; a link to a missing #archive target; links to missing pages

axe._seeded: an unlabelled input, an image without alt, low-contrast text

keyboard._seeded: a clickable div that is not focusable; a button with outline:none and no replacement

dialogs._seeded: a role=dialog aria-modal=true that takes no focus, has no Esc, no trap and no focus return

layout._seeded: a 900 px block; text in a 22 px box with hidden overflow; a one-line box that clips under text spacing and 200% text

palette._seeded: a saturated blue hero over about half of the first viewport on an Operate surface (Restrained by default)

targets._seeded: 14 px buttons 2 px apart; a 14 px submit button on touch widths

contrast._seeded: #b0b0b0 text on white; input borders #e3e3e3 on white

forms._seeded: an unlabelled input and placeholder-only fields; paste blocked on a password field; the generic error "Invalid" not tied to a field

live-regions._seeded: "Draft saved" written 200 ms after a click into a plain div

cross-page._seeded: ?variant=b reorders the main navigation and renames "Orders"

cvd._seeded: evidence only (A11Y-19 is judged by the accessibility auditor): four colour-vision captures and one forced-colours capture of colour-only status dots

census._seeded: 10 px text; line height 1.05 on three lines; weight 200 at 14 px

states._seeded: flat buttons without hover or active styles; a disabled button shown only by opacity 0.25

motion._seeded: transition: all; a 900 ms state transition; an overshooting curve; an infinite marquee under reduced motion; a reveal that never fires; scale(0) entrance; load choreography on an Operate surface

tells._seeded: gradient text; emoji used as icons; a decorative side stripe

copy._seeded: lorem ipsum; "click here"; Jane Doe and jane@example.com

i18n._seeded: Chinese text set in system-ui with no CJK family

vitals._seeded: a 240 px banner inserted above the content after load; a click handler that blocks for 350 ms
